_meta.law: source of truth for collections. a collection holds pages of one section (section field - pages live under pages/<section>/collections/). a multi-collection holds collections. engine: tools/build.py.

collections.title: The Complete Hitman
collections.caption: the four hits the owner listed, 2002 to 2012, with the consoles' remaster riding the shelf.
about: The Hitman games the archive's list actually names: Silent Assassin's conscience, Contracts' dark detour, Blood Money's sandbox peak, Absolution's cinematic detour. The full lineage - Codename 47 (2000) through the World of Assassination line (2016-2023) - lives on every page's series strip, so the complete family is always one glance away even where its pages are not dug yet.

The classics (2002-2006) run on and under the haswell iGPU bar and are still sold DRM-free. Absolution sits at the target line with its 24GB body. Every page carries the same law: official path first where one exists, the archive route right next to it.

The remaster truth: the series' only classic-line remaster is the Hitman HD Enhanced Collection (2019) - Blood Money + Absolution rebuilt at 4K/60 for PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, never windows. Silent Assassin and Contracts were never remastered at all. The windows builds on this shelf are therefore not stepping stones - they are the final windows truth.
notes: Codename 47, the World of Assassination trilogy and the spinoffs (GO, Sniper, Sniper Challenge) are out of the current dig scope - their entries ride the series strip, and they come back as pages when the owner wants them.

collections.title: The Complete Chicken Invaders
collections.caption: the complete line: five wars, the remaster line, and the universe - 1999 to today.
about: One hundred percent of the Chicken Invaders line the owner listed: the five mainline episodes with every holiday release living as a version under its episode's page (Christmas x4, Easter x2, Halloween x1, Thanksgiving x1 - switched from the dropdown, not scattered as standalone catalog entries), plus the two things that complete the family: the Remastered line and Universe.

The production quirk the shelf keeps honest: the third war's Christmas Edition (November 2006) shipped before the standard game (January 2007), making it the only edition in the series that predates its own episode.

InterAction studios is alive and every entry on this shelf is still obtainable through an official channel: the studio's own download hub carries the classic line, Steam sells the mainline episodes and all eight holiday editions (every app page and price verified 2026-10-09), the remaster line rides the studio's package, and Universe is free to play. these pages are ownership stories, not rescues - the archive links ride along for preservation.

The upgrade law of this shelf: a sequel is never an upgrade. The four classic episodes point their UPGRADE lines at the Remastered line - the per-episode rebuilds that carry all DLC - while the series strip carries the lineage from the 1999 original to Universe.
notes: Chicken Invaders: Remastered is not a game of its own: it is the studio's remaster line covering the classic episodes and their DLCs, and the direct upgrade of every old game on this shelf. it holds a page so the upgrade lines have a real destination and the line has one honest address.
